Title: Fix stale pinned fallback tag in Setup-LlamaCpp.ps1
Description: installer/scripts/Setup-LlamaCpp.ps1 uses hardcoded fallback tag 'b5695' described as 'approximate pinned tag — user should update if stale'. This tag may not exist in GitHub Releases, producing a broken download URL. Fix: replace with a resolved latest release URL from the API response, or use the GitHub releases/latest redirect approach.
